reviews.review:
Liminal Waters is a walking simulator with, yup, you guessed it, (mostly) liminal space / pools environments to explore. There are no enemies that attack you or chase you in this game. However, I have spotted a few interesting oddities that move around in the distance that can creep you out. There are 1-2 minor puzzles in this game. One runthrough of the game takes approximately 3 hours to complete. There is an a chapter select at the end of the game which is excellent for cleaning up achievements. To complete all achievements and explore 100% of the game, it took me 5 hours.

+ The game runs on the latest Unreal graphics / ray tracing, and is gorgeous. You will need a high end PC for full effect.
+ Most of the games in this genre, your character walks super slow. In this game your character can run fast and jump, which is great. The levels are very large.
+ The sound effects, soundscapes, and music, are original by the developer and well made.
+ Achievements provide alot of fun replayability. Trying to find all the secret areas is fun.

+/- The levels are not "Maze like". You can generally find your way around with minimal effort. This is not typical for the genre, some people might like this change, but some people might want more challenge and enjoy getting lost in these types of environments.
+/- The last level has a different enviroment than the rest of the game, and this will throw many people off. The level is beautifully designed, however it is not liminal and has nothing to do with water.

I had alot of fun exporing the environments in this game!
Overall: 9/10
